Hi Lina —

Thanks again for the quick intro yesterday. Per our convo I want to lock in a short technical run-through with our Solutions Engineering (SE) lead and your customer engineers so we can validate the integration points and confirm any network/security prerequisites before the POC.

Goals for the session (30–45 min):
- SE demo of the inference flow and API (KV cache, batching, auth)
- Walkthrough of customer infra requirements (eg VPC egress, KMS rules)
- Agree on telemetry/logging and redaction for the POC

Who from our side: Alex Martinez (SE) and Karthik Iyer (security/compliance).
Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Oct 6 — 10:00–10:45
- Tue Oct 6 — 15:00–15:45
Please let me know which works or suggest two alternatives. I attached a short agenda and an environment checklist to speed up prep.

If you want procurement on the intro call we can loop them in, but we typically separate procurement/contracting until technical fit is validated.

Thanks,
Hannah
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (650) 555-0192
redwoodinference.com

Hi Lina / Hannah —

11:30 PT on Tue Oct 6 works for me. If we take the 45-minute slot I’ll plan: 15m architecture + 15m hands-on demo with a short load test + 15m Q&A and infra checklist review.

Prep notes for Sam / your infra team:
- If you can share a short network diagram or note whether the POC will run in your VPC vs our hosted endpoint that’ll help me tailor the demo.
- We may ask for a temporary API key and a sample request payload for the hands-on part (no production data).
- For KMS/keys — is there an existing HSM or KMS policy we should be aware of? If not, we’ll show standard recommendations.

I attached a one-slide diagram and the minimal commands I’ll run (text snippet). Happy to record the session if helpful.
